assumptions: The source grammar is i for the Iota combinator and *AB for application; any other character is refused.
The Iota rule is j a -> a S K, with I a -> a, K a b -> a and S x y z -> x z (y z).
Reduction order is leftmost-outermost on combinator trees.
One contraction is counted per applied combinator and named by that combinator.
nodes(t) counts one per application and one per leaf.
The normal-form digest is SHA-256 over the canonical JSON encoding ["a",f,x], ["c",name], ["v",name], ["l",name,body].
The coordinate families apply the program to the declared four-slot product Z(p,q,r,s) = lambda k. k p q r s through bracket abstraction without eta optimization.
The named value and its evidence are project-original contributions admitted on 2026-09-19 under Unknown v0.3; no third-party expressive material is incorporated.
open_obligations: This entry is a proposed document: the receiving profile registers no checker and no evidence for it, and it grants no native admission.
The unit retains no counted combinator reduction for the named value P alone; only its self-application, its coordinate families and its beta normal form are frozen.
The 2x2 table adjoint programs and their sixteen assertions are not part of this transport package.
The text probe, the declared end-leaf representation bridge, the Zot CEK stage and the retained failed reflection control are not replayed by this transport.

A choice of real form or grading is required at the carrier boundary: the carrier's Omega is minus the frame's canonical J, J alone does not select a unique C, and the carrier contraction symbol is not the Iota combinator.
reuse_requires: Retain the exact transported bytes at their recorded digests; a changed program changes the reduction.
Keep the declared source grammar, rule set, reduction order, node counting and digest encoding together; any one of them alone does not identify the witness.
Re-run the external checker from the retained materials rather than citing this entry as a result.
Keep the non-frozen families recorded rather than promoted: a recorded row is not a matched oracle.
entry.scope: The published murphy unit retained in this repository: the named Iota value obtained from Zot word 0001011011 before the stop/printer wrapper, its ordinary self-application, the three coordinate permutation programs on the declared four-slot product, and the frozen counted witness for those families. This catalog entry registers a documentary reference only. It makes no native judgment, installs no operation and repeats no proof; the unit's own external checker, its evidence and its residuals remain with the unit at experiments/murphy.
